provenance_note: This replacement evidence record was created on 2026-10-14 to repair the missing [E3] file. The filename preserves the reference already present in the Phase 3 document; it does not imply that this JSON existed on 2026-10-12.
method: Read-only inspection of repository source files and Git blob identities at the pinned commit. No training or inference was run as part of this source review.
scope: Source-level comparison of E2_finetune (224px without augmentation) and E4_augment (224px with augmentation), and identification of how stored validation predictions were exported.

inspected_code_findings.finding: The default invocation uses image size 224 and augmentation disabled (E2). The --augment flag enables the augmenter and selects E4_augment by default. The model-building and training functions are shared.

E4 configures RandomFlip(horizontal), RandomTranslation(0.1, 0.1), RandomZoom(0.1), RandomBrightness(0.15; value range 0..255) and RandomContrast(0.15; value range 0..255); preprocessing is decode JPEG, resize, optional augmentation with training=True, then ResNet-50 preprocess_input.
The training dataset is built with the optional augmenter. Validation is built without the augmenter.

ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 with include_top=False and average pooling; non-conv5 layers frozen; backbone invoked with training=False; regression head Dropout(0.2), Dense(256, relu), Dense(1); Adam learning rate 0.0001 and MSE loss.

Dataset uses seeded shuffling for training, batch size from config, labels standardised using training mean and population standard deviation, a default 15-epoch cap, and early stopping on val_loss with patience 4 and best-weight restoration; predictions are clipped to the training label range after inverse target scaling.
Seed 42 is configured centrally, and the experiment loads existing committed training/validation split CSV files instead of recreating the split during training.
Metric functions calculate mean squared error, mean absolute error and coefficient of determination (R2) from supplied labels and predictions.

Validation price_pred, residual and abs_error columns are independently rounded to one decimal place on CSV export; therefore an audit of committed CSVs need not exactly reproduce full-precision historical run metrics.
The historical report records E2 validation MSE approximately 102745.7 and E4 approximately 108784.5. These are historical records, not new computations from this source review.
Generated artifacts under outputs are generally excluded from ordinary commits except prediction CSVs, and model checkpoint extensions are ignored.

limitations: These findings describe inspected source code at the pinned commit; they do not independently prove that historical experiments were run under all those exact defaults.
A shared configured seed does not establish identical model-head initialisation or random draws across runs.
